chapter: Mingus and the call from Hampton
title: Heroes Ray Brown, Mingus and Pettiford; Mingus comes to town
summary: Monk wanted to meet Charlie Mingus when Hampton's band came through with Wes, ranking Brown, Mingus and Pettiford as heroes.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Well, then, you got a call from Hamp.

Yeah. I got this call to join Hamp's band. And that just about put me away because I couldn't imagine...I had experienced a period where Hamp had come in town, when Wes was with him, and I'm saying they had those two bass players. That's when I had last saw the band, with Charlie Harris on bass and Charlie Mingus. And when they came to town, Wes was working with the band. It gave me an opportunity to meet the players. And naturally I was saying to Wes, 'Man, I sure would like to have dinner over at my house and invite some of the guys over, especially Charlie Mingus.' Especially Charlie Mingus. I had to meet Charlie.

Oh, yeah. He was really my idol, one of my idols. My real heros were Ray Brown, Charlie Mingus. I mean really heros. Of course, we know Jimmy Blanton had gone on, and we all had the highest respect for him. But these guys were an extension from that, you know...

They were here. And there was those two and Oscar Pettiford. Ray Brown, Charlie Mingus and Oscar Pettiford, and almost in that order. Because to me, that was the essence of the instrument. And here Charlie Mingus was, in town, with Hamp's band. Wes made it possible that we had dinner at the house and Charlie Mingus was there for dinner. And just him being in my house was just like a whole glow over things, like.
